t: Don't Raise The Bridge, Lower The River
d: A schemer hatches a plan to convert a swinging Chinese discotheque back into his wife's ancestral home.
A comic with gambling debts runs away to Chicago, and under an assumed name, takes a job as a janitor.
Sinbad is forced to return to the magical isle of Colossa in search of a secret.
A widowed clothing manufacturer falls in love with one of his employees.
